@T018 : ∀ {V : Type} [instVAdd : AddCommGroup V] [instVMod : Module ℂ V] (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (K : Type) [instK : Field K]
  (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  (ScalarReduction p K M ∧ ReducedBasis p lam K M x y h v ∧ ReducedUnits lam K M x y h ∧ ∃ a, Agrees M x y h a) →
    (∀ (a : LatticeOps M) (W : Submodule K (VK K M)),
        Agrees M x y h a →
          Invariant W (LinearMap.baseChange K a.x) →
            Invariant W (LinearMap.baseChange K a.y) →
              Invariant W (LinearMap.baseChange K a.h) →
                ∀ (i j : Index lam),
                  Invariant W
                    (MatrixWord lam (fun r => LinearMap.baseChange K (a.X r)) (fun r => LinearMap.baseChange K (a.Y r))
                      i j)) →
      ∀ (a : LatticeOps M),
        Agrees M x y h a → Simple (LinearMap.baseChange K a.x) (LinearMap.baseChange K a.y) (LinearMap.baseChange K a.h)
'Translation.T018' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
